verification.purpose: Port gates (files, no-style, verbatim CSS, prop parity, manifest shape)
verification.evidence: combobox: no errors; only prop warnings for intentional additions (open, onOpenChange, id, disabled).

gaps: Phase 1 still-state: the list mounts when open at its resting end-state with no enter/exit travel; the clear button renders statically; the chosen label swaps without the rise-in/blur settle. Phase 2 wires the popover spring, list auto-height morph, clear-button scale/blur, and the label settle animation.

ARC source is custom-built (no Radix primitives), so there were no ARC primitive parts to map 1:1. bits-ui Combobox (Root type=single, ContentStatic, Item) hosts open/value/selection, list semantics, outside-dismiss, and data-state; the text field keeps ARC query/display/keyboard logic with identical aria (role=combobox, aria-expanded/controls/autocomplete/activedescendant).

CSS kept verbatim, so the highlight hook stays data-active: it is driven by ARC activeIndex state synced from bits Item onHighlight/onUnhighlight (pointer and keyboard). bits-ui additionally sets data-highlighted, which is unstyled.
Option ids are passed explicitly to bits Items so the input aria-activedescendant references keep working.
AutoHeight ResizeObserver morph dropped (the list sizes naturally and scrolls via CSS); active-option scroll-into-view kept via a $effect with scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }).
Outside-dismiss is owned by bits-ui DismissibleLayer, replacing the document pointerdown listener; Escape is owned by bits-ui EscapeLayer plus the ARC query reset.

Combobox Trigger/Input/Portal/Viewport/ScrollButtons parts not applicable: ARC has no trigger button (the input owns focus), content renders statically in place (ARC CSS absolute positioning), and the list scrolls natively. No forceMount: the menu mounts on open, matching ARC AnimatePresence mount/unmount; no {#if} is written around any bits presence part.

React-only className dropped in favour of Svelte class. Added bindable open/onOpenChange for control through the bits-ui host and bindable ref to the text field (check-port prop warnings, intentional).
lucide-react imports mapped to @lucide/svelte/icons/<kebab> (search, chevron-down, check, x) with ARC size/strokeWidth preserved.
